newsitem.title: USA: Cellular sees "small loss" for Q2.
newsitem.headline: Cellular sees "small loss" for Q2.

text.p: Cellular Technical Services Co Inc said Tuesday its second quarter revenues and earnings will fall below analysts expectations and it will record "a small loss" for the quarter.
The First Call consensus earnings per share estimate for Cellular had been a second quarter profit of $0.12 versus a loss of $0.09 a year ago.
The company said the anticipated loss is attributable to delays in orders of the company's Blackbird Platform system.

The company said it had expected to ship more than 500 cell site systems during the second quarter, with more than half scheduled for delivery in June, but delays in receiving additional orders from existing customers and longer than anticipated negotiations with potential new customers delayed shipments.

The company attributed the slower orders, in part, to delays in deploying its latest software release. The company said it expects to recognize revenue on about 200 units, rather than the 500 originally forecast.
The company also said it had signed several new contracts for domestic and international sales of the Blackbird system.
